title: SmimeError::SignatureVerification is defined but never constructed
description: error.rs defines SmimeError::SignatureVerification (line 51) and its Display branch (line 76), but it is never constructed anywhere in the codebase. All actual signature failures use SmimeError::Other(String) instead. A future maintainer seeing this variant will expect it to be produced by verify() or sig_verify::* but it never is. The dead variant either needs to be removed (breaking change — needs deprecation) or all per-signer signature failures need to be routed through it. As-is it is documentation that lies.
close_reason: Fixed: check_message_digest now returns SignatureVerification (not Other). The variant is no longer dead code.
